label: It is impossible that there be no first…, from Something in this world is being moved… and 6 more
meaning: Aquinas' prima via: sensible motion, the act-potency derivation that whatever is moved is moved by another, the per se ordering of moved movers, and the impossibility of an infinite per se series together make it impossible that there be no first mover moved by none. The identification of that mover with God is a separate claim outside this argument.

strong_version_needed.1e47e6db-da06-5a40-9ccf-fbd1f929c596: The conclusion is the absolute a nullo movetur; with the relevant-respect link in its place the premises do not yield it (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-WEAK-READING-DOES-NOT-YIELD-UNMOVED-MOVER, a finite model in which every being is moved). The weak link yields only the relative conclusion (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-PRIMA-VIA-RELATIVE).
